seed.name: combined immunodeficiency due to DOCK8 deficiency

partners.mechanism_chain: DOCK8 (HGNC:2780) —DISRUPTS→ Rac1/Cdc42 activation (GO:0007249); Rac1/Cdc42 activation (GO:0007249) —DECREASES→ PAK2 (HGNC:8568); PAK2 (HGNC:8568) —DISRUPTS→ cytoskeletal regulation (GO:0007010); cytoskeletal regulation (GO:0007010) —LEADS_TO→ combined immunodeficiency (HP:0002714); cytoskeletal regulation (GO:0007010) —LEADS_TO→ occipital encephalocele (HP:0002091); cytoskeletal regulation (GO:0007010) —LEADS_TO→ subcutaneous]]]] (HP:0030673). Loss-of-function mutations in DOCK8 lead to impaired activation of Rac1/Cdc42, which in turn reduces the activation and/or function of downstream effector PAK2. This disruption in the PAK signaling pathway affects cytoskeletal regulation, leading to combined immunodeficiency (Disease A).
